cases.scope: Paired simulation diagnostic of estimated versus known Gaussian nuisance parameters. Same counts, identities, model settings and Gaussian innovations per paired draw. One shared observed point fit. Known-law results are not empirical p-values, a correction, general size guarantee or species-boundary evidence. No stability resampling.
